messages:
Amina K: Hey everyone, Amina here (first day!). My calendar shows TWO events called "New Hire Orientation" both at 08:00 but one has the Zoom link and the other shows an "Add conferencing" button. One lists the time as 08:00 PST and the other as 08:00 UTC. I'm in Nairobi (EAT) so times look weird. Also there's an "Office tour" event scheduled at the same time. Which one should I join? @Jordan L? :wave:

Jordan L: Welcome Amina! :tada: Join the event that has the Zoom link — that's our canonical global orientation (we record that). The office tour is optional and should not block you. Looks like two schedulers fired (PeopleOps + OfficeOps) and the timezone metadata mismatch is causing duplicates. We'll sort it out.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation starts at 08:00 AM ET. Zoom join URL: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/global-2026. Recording will be uploaded to S3 and posted to Confluence after the session. If your invite lacks conferencing, check the PeopleOps calendar or reply here.

Amina K: On mobile I only see the tour; on desktop I see both orientation entries overlapping. The duplicate is messing with reminders.

IT Support: Hi Amina  we pulled the invites. Two different schedulers created events with different TZ fields (organizer tz=America/Los_Angeles vs tz=UTC). Some clients render both when TZs differ. We're going to: (1) normalize the orientation invite timezone to America/New_York and resend with conferenceData/joinUrl + passcode in the description; (2) change the office tour subject to "Optional: Office Tour" and shift it 30m later so it doesn't conflict. We'll also stop the OfficeOps auto-invite from using the same title. Resending now to `new-hires-2026`.

OfficeOps: Sorry about the noise  we auto-sent tours to the onsite list. We'll update the auto-invite template to include "Optional: Office Tour" in the title and avoid the word "Orientation" so calendar clients don't merge them.

IT Support: New invites sent. If you still see duplicates, please delete both and add from the new invite; or DM screenshots and we'll manually fix your calendar entry.

Amina K: New invite arrived and I re-added it. Zoom link and passcode are visible; office tour is marked optional and moved to 08:30. Time converts correctly to 16:00 EAT for me now. Thanks so much! :thumbsup:

PeopleOps Bot: Recording will be uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-onboarding/recordings/1905000000.mp4 and mirrored to Confluence under /onboarding/recordings within 60 minutes after the session. If you missed it, book a "New Hire Catch-up" with PeopleOps.
